metadata.target_venue_type: Weed science or agronomy journal; PRISMA 2020 reporting
metadata.title: Herbicide use and weed control with UAV-guided site-specific application versus uniform application: a systematic review of comparative field trials

epistemology.unit_of_analysis: Comparative field trials (one site-season per trial)
epistemology.trustworthiness_framework: PRISMA 2020 with a risk-of-bias assessment of each trial
epistemology.epistemological_rationale: Pooling herbicide savings and efficacy across trials needs comparable quantitative outcomes, so a positivist stance with a random-effects synthesis is used.

research_questions.text: In arable crops, does herbicide application guided by UAV weed maps use less herbicide per hectare than uniform whole-field application?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Random-effects meta-analysis of percentage herbicide saving
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Herbicide quantity per hectare for both arms

research_questions.text: Does map-guided application change weed control efficacy or crop yield compared with uniform application in the same trials?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Random-effects meta-analysis of weed control and yield differences
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Weed density, biomass or yield for both arms

research_questions.text: Which trial conditions (crop, weed density, flight altitude, map resolution) are associated with larger or smaller herbicide savings?
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Trial-level covariates reported for each trial

inclusion.criterion: Compares herbicide application guided by a weed map made from UAV images with uniform whole-field application, in the same crop and field.
Is a field trial or field experiment with a uniform-application control arm run at the same time, randomized or not.
Reports numerically, for both arms, the herbicide quantity used and at least one of weed control efficacy or crop yield.
Was published in English in 2010 or later.

exclusion.criterion: Builds the weed map from satellite, ground-vehicle or manned-aircraft images, with no UAV-derived map.
Has no uniform-application control arm (for example a simulation, a model-only study or a weed-detection accuracy study with no spraying trial).
Is a review, editorial, commentary, study protocol or conference abstract with no trial data.
Reports a trial that is already included through another report (keep the most complete report).

matrix_dimensions.name: Crop and site
matrix_dimensions.description: Crop, location, year, soil, weed species and weed density at the start.

matrix_dimensions.name: UAV map source
matrix_dimensions.description: Sensor, flight altitude, map resolution and the rule that turned the weed map into a spraying map.

matrix_dimensions.name: Herbicide quantity, both arms
matrix_dimensions.description: Herbicide quantity per hectare in the map-guided arm and in the uniform arm, with units.

matrix_dimensions.name: Weed control efficacy
matrix_dimensions.description: Weed density or biomass reduction for both arms, with timing of assessment.

matrix_dimensions.name: Crop yield
matrix_dimensions.description: Yield per hectare for both arms, with units.

matrix_dimensions.name: Risk of bias
matrix_dimensions.description: Randomization, replication, blinding of assessment and attrition, rated low, some concerns or high.
